description: Storm type definitions for environmental hazards in star systems. PROJ-300 migrated to abilities-dict shape — each storm type declares an `abilities` block matching the components.json convention. Multipliers use 'multiplier'; rates use 'rate' (per-turn). Storms are sector-scope and have no shared stack_group, so overlapping storms multiply per-provider.

ion_storm.name: Ion Storm
ion_storm.description: Electromagnetic disturbance that disrupts shields and sensors. Common near active stars.

plasma_storm.name: Plasma Storm
plasma_storm.description: Superheated plasma ejected from stellar activity. Damages unshielded hulls.

gravitational_anomaly.name: Gravitational Anomaly
gravitational_anomaly.description: Spacetime distortion causing thrust inefficiency. Common in binary systems.

radiation_belt.name: Radiation Belt
radiation_belt.description: Intense radiation zone causing gradual hull damage. Often found near gas giants.

dark_nebula.name: Dark Nebula
dark_nebula.description: Dense gas cloud that slows travel but provides cover. Minimal direct harm.
